newsitem.title: USA: IBM awarded most U.S. patents in 1996.
newsitem.headline: IBM awarded most U.S. patents in 1996.

text.p: International Business Machines Corp Monday said it was awarded the most U.S. patents for the fourth straight year, receiving a record 1,867 from from the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office.
The figures were based on data from IFI/Plenum Data Corp of Wilmington, N.C.
In 1995, IBM was awarded 1,383 U.S. patents, the firm said.
Following IBM in the list of top U.S. patent recipients were Canon Inc with 1,538 patents, Motorola Inc with 1064, NEC Corp with 1,042, and Hitachi AIC Inc with 961.
Next were Mitsubishi Electric Corp with 932, Toshiba Corp with 912, Fujitsu Ltd with 868, Sony Corp with 854, Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd with 837, and General Electric Co with 819.

Among IBM's patents were an audio conferencing system that allows users to separately adjust audio levels from each conferencing workstation, and a desktop computer system that allows users to suspend a system in a power-saving sleep mode and restore the exact state of the system quickly.
